title: Schuster Vendor Payment Intelligence
tagline: Two-stage ML pipeline: K-Means segmentation + Random Forest late payment prediction across 500+ vendors.
summary: A two-stage machine learning pipeline that segments 500+ vendors with K-Means clustering and predicts late payments with a Random Forest model, with results reported in Power BI.

approach: Stage 1: segmented vendors with K-Means clustering.
Stage 2: trained a Random Forest model to predict late payments.
caseStudy.solution: A two-stage ML pipeline covering 500+ vendors, combining vendor segmentation with late-payment prediction, with results surfaced in Power BI.
